gs-superadmin — the Claude Code plugin that bootstraps per-tenant Gainsight workspaces on the gs-admin CLI, with a mutation guard that asks before any catalog-mutating command. Refresh an installed copy with `claude plugin marketplace update gs-admin-cli-docs`, then `claude plugin update gs-superadmin@gs-admin-cli-docs`.
